fields.name: Lion
fields.short_description: Lions are powerful wild animals known as the kings of the jungle.
fields.full_description: Lions are social wild cats. They live mainly in groups called prides.

fields.name: Tiger
fields.short_description: Tigers are strong and beautiful wild cats with unique stripes.
fields.full_description: Tigers are the largest members of the cat family and are known for their stripes.

fields.name: Elephant
fields.short_description: Elephants are the largest land animals and are highly intelligent.
fields.full_description: Elephants are intelligent mammals and are the largest land animals.

fields.name: Giraffe
fields.short_description: Giraffes are famous for their long necks and tall bodies.
fields.full_description: Giraffes are the tallest land animals and use their long necks to reach leaves.

fields.name: Panda
fields.short_description: Giant pandas are known for their black and white fur and love for bamboo.
fields.full_description: Giant pandas mainly eat bamboo and are known for their distinctive black and white fur.

fields.name: Dog
fields.short_description: Dogs are friendly, intelligent and loyal companions.
fields.full_description: Dogs are intelligent and social animals that have lived alongside humans for thousands of years.
